test.name: native Finance checks a human-selected budget KPI without replacing forecast delta or inventing comparable currency
test.uncovered_normative_operation: sf_import_preview; separate existing import mission, not exercised here

classification_correction.prior: The previous addendum treated a common producer/currency relation as an owner prerequisite for every Forecast-to-KPI call.
classification_correction.current: No canonical or mounted-verifier rule was found requiring every auxiliary read to enter the closed FinancialAnalysis. A real human-selected public budget source of the same case and period can be checked separately, with its true currency/unit and receipts. This is an own driver obligation; actual execution remains NOT_RUN.
classification_correction.not_inferred: Numerically matching budgets do not establish same-source financial equivalence, FX or a cross-producer margin.

public_reference_flow: Human issues an actual Budget Overview budgetMetrics selection through createDashboardSourceIssuer.
Human issues two actual Planner forecasts and drafts one real C09 case containing all three source refs for the same2027 horizon.
The objective explicitly identifies the human-selected public budget source; no autonomous discovery or private artifact handle is claimed.
Native sf_context_get resolves that exact public selection before sf_kpi_explain in a later assistant message. Three native sf_source_get receipts must cover the selected sources.
Native sf_forecast_compare supplies the exact replay. The verifier and assertions keep FinancialAnalysis payload/evidenceRefs equal to the two-forecast replay.
After a fresh host opens the same store, the real HTTP FinancialAnalysis consumer and durable Session tool receipts/results are re-read independently.
purpose: Check whether the human-selected budget KPI is a comparable measure or a distinct quantity before confusing it with change against the forecast baseline. The KPI producer currency remains unspecified; Planner remains USD. The real KPI producer refuses monetary comparison with comparison-basis-unavailable. No combined margin or conversion is calculated.

real_producers_and_consumers.forecast: Actual Planner source issuance and compareForecast; known590000/596000 and delta6000 are assertions on producer results, with null complete difference and conditioned coverage.
real_producers_and_consumers.auxiliary: Actual public Dashboard KPI source -> sf_context_get/sf_kpi_explain/source_get. UI receipts count as UI only; native receipts must originate in Session/SkillLoadReceipt execution.
real_producers_and_consumers.closed_contribution: Actual FinancialAnalysis publication and handleSfAnalysis:output after reload when a real model is available.
real_producers_and_consumers.auxiliary_consumer: Actual model tool result and durable Session audit after reload; otherwise authenticated UI result only.

required_negatives: Real KPI producer refuses comparison when currency is unspecified; no driver-made FX/margin substitutes for it.
Planner selector formatted as a Dashboard metric and unselected period are refused by actual scope resolution.
Request outside the private explicit synthetic authenticator is refused before UI dispatch.
After all positive consumers, remove the actual selected Dashboard raw source: old KPI/context references must be refused while Planner raw versions/officials stay unchanged.
If a native contribution exists, re-read it after source removal even if the reopened catalog is empty; availability never disables the current-source fence.
preservation: No existing driver, harness, contract, domain producer, grant or financial policy edited.
No synthetic model/run/receipt/output or seeded C08 case/choice/contribution; only explicit raw business inputs are supplied.
Sources selected by the human are the only business basis. No schema expansion or source injection into FinancialAnalysis.
The real provider branch requires actual Session, skill-load receipt, completed calls, result digests and consumers; an empty catalog records unavailability.
No local product tests or typecheck; no remote CI triggered by author.
